More sharply H(S_X|S_Y)<=sum_{i in X,d_i>=1} kappa(d_i)J_i-TC(S_X)-I(S_X;S_Y). Using the separately imported physical block-channel bound, H(f)-E_t H(f_t)<=[kappa(d)+2/ln2] I_X(f). Terminal Y entropy is retained; no universal bounded d is asserted.
